categories.name: RetailTech
categories.description: Retail technology, omnichannel commerce, and point-of-sale systems

questions.text: What is your point-of-sale (POS) system deployment scale?
questions.helpText: Track number of active POS terminals or stores using your system. IRL 1-2: Concept/demo, IRL 3-4: 1-10 locations, IRL 5-6: 10-100 locations, IRL 7-8: 100-1K locations, IRL 9: 1K+ locations or major retailers

options.text: Concept or demo environment only
1-10 retail locations or pilot deployment
10-100 locations with paying customers
100-500 locations or small-to-medium chain deployment
500-1,000 locations or regional chain penetration
1,000+ locations or multiple national retailers using platform

questions.text: What is your monthly transaction processing volume?
questions.helpText: Measure transactions processed per month. IRL 1-2: <1K transactions, IRL 3-4: 1K-10K, IRL 5-6: 10K-100K, IRL 7-8: 100K-1M, IRL 9: 1M+ transactions/month

options.text: <1,000 transactions/month (early testing)
1,000-10,000 transactions/month
10,000-100,000 transactions/month
100,000-500,000 transactions/month
500,000-1,000,000 transactions/month
1,000,000+ transactions/month with 99.9%+ uptime

questions.text: What omnichannel capabilities have you implemented?
questions.helpText: Track unified commerce features: inventory visibility, BOPIS, endless aisle, etc. IRL 1-2: Single channel, IRL 3-4: Basic multi-channel, IRL 5-6: Unified inventory, IRL 7-8: Full omnichannel (BOPIS, ship-from-store), IRL 9: AI-powered unified commerce

options.text: Single channel only (in-store OR online)
Basic multi-channel (separate online and in-store inventory)
Unified inventory visibility across channels
BOPIS (buy online, pick up in store) and basic cross-channel fulfillment
Full omnichannel: BOPIS, ship-from-store, endless aisle, unified customer view
AI-powered unified commerce with personalized omnichannel experiences

questions.text: What is your inventory accuracy rate?
questions.helpText: Measure real-time inventory accuracy %. IRL 1-2: <80% accuracy, IRL 3-4: 80-90%, IRL 5-6: 90-95%, IRL 7-8: 95-98%, IRL 9: 98%+ accuracy with RFID/real-time tracking

options.text: <80% inventory accuracy (manual tracking)
80-90% accuracy with periodic cycle counts
90-95% accuracy with regular audits and reconciliation
95-97% accuracy with automated systems and frequent counts
97-98.5% accuracy with RFID or IoT sensors
98.5%+ accuracy with real-time tracking and AI-powered reconciliation

questions.text: What payment methods and integrations do you support?
questions.helpText: Track payment flexibility and compliance. IRL 1-2: Cash/basic cards, IRL 3-4: Major credit cards, IRL 5-6: Digital wallets + contactless, IRL 7-8: BNPL + multi-currency, IRL 9: All payment types + PCI Level 1

options.text: Cash and basic card processing only
Major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex) with EMV support
Digital wallets (Apple Pay, Google Pay) and contactless payments
BNPL (buy now, pay later) integrations and gift cards
Multi-currency, alternative payments, and loyalty integration
All payment types, cryptocurrency, PCI DSS Level 1 certified

questions.text: What customer data and personalization capabilities do you have?
questions.helpText: Assess CDP, segmentation, and personalization. IRL 1-2: No CDP, IRL 3-4: Basic customer database, IRL 5-6: Segmentation and targeting, IRL 7-8: Real-time personalization, IRL 9: AI-powered predictive personalization

options.text: No unified customer data platform
Basic customer database with purchase history
Customer segmentation with basic targeting capabilities
Unified customer profiles with behavioral data and RFM analysis
Real-time personalization with A/B testing and product recommendations
AI-powered predictive personalization with CLV optimization and next-best-action

questions.text: What supply chain visibility and management do you provide?
questions.helpText: Track end-to-end supply chain tracking. IRL 1-2: No visibility, IRL 3-4: Basic order tracking, IRL 5-6: Multi-tier visibility, IRL 7-8: Real-time tracking with alerts, IRL 9: AI-powered supply chain optimization

options.text: No supply chain visibility beyond immediate orders
Basic order and shipment tracking
Multi-tier supplier visibility and inventory tracking
Real-time supply chain visibility with automated alerts
End-to-end visibility with predictive analytics and risk management
AI-powered supply chain optimization with demand forecasting and automated replenishment

questions.text: What checkout innovations have you implemented?
questions.helpText: Track checkout speed and innovation. IRL 1-2: Traditional cashier, IRL 3-4: Self-checkout, IRL 5-6: Mobile checkout, IRL 7-8: Scan & go or frictionless, IRL 9: Fully autonomous checkout (just walk out)

options.text: Traditional cashier-operated checkout only
Self-checkout kiosks available
Mobile checkout or line-busting capabilities
Scan & go mobile app or curbside pickup integration
Frictionless checkout with computer vision (just walk out technology pilot)
Fully autonomous checkout at scale with biometric payment

questions.text: What loss prevention and shrinkage reduction systems do you have?
questions.helpText: Track shrinkage rate and loss prevention tech. IRL 1-2: >3% shrinkage, IRL 3-4: 2-3%, IRL 5-6: 1-2% with basic systems, IRL 7-8: 0.5-1% with AI/video, IRL 9: <0.5% shrinkage with advanced analytics

options.text: >3% shrinkage rate (limited loss prevention)
2-3% shrinkage with basic EAS tags and cameras
1-2% shrinkage with RFID and surveillance systems
0.5-1% shrinkage with AI-powered video analytics
0.3-0.5% shrinkage with real-time alerts and exception-based reporting
<0.3% shrinkage with advanced behavioral analytics and integrated systems

questions.text: What loyalty program capabilities do you offer?
questions.helpText: Assess loyalty features and engagement. IRL 1-2: No loyalty program, IRL 3-4: Basic points, IRL 5-6: Tiered program, IRL 7-8: Personalized rewards, IRL 9: AI-powered loyalty with gamification

options.text: No loyalty program integration
Basic points-based loyalty program
Tiered loyalty program with member benefits
Personalized rewards and targeted promotions based on purchase history
Omnichannel loyalty with experiential rewards and partner integrations
AI-powered loyalty with predictive rewards, gamification, and social features

questions.text: What analytics and business intelligence capabilities do you provide?
questions.helpText: Track reporting sophistication. IRL 1-2: Basic sales reports, IRL 3-4: KPI dashboards, IRL 5-6: Advanced analytics, IRL 7-8: Predictive analytics, IRL 9: AI-powered prescriptive analytics

options.text: Basic sales and transaction reports only
KPI dashboards with standard retail metrics
Advanced analytics with cohort analysis and custom reports
Predictive analytics for demand forecasting and inventory optimization
Real-time business intelligence with automated insights and anomaly detection
AI-powered prescriptive analytics with actionable recommendations and scenario modeling

questions.text: What e-commerce platform integrations do you support?
questions.helpText: Track integrations with Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, etc. IRL 1-2: No integrations, IRL 3-4: 1-2 platforms, IRL 5-6: 3-5 major platforms, IRL 7-8: 5-10 platforms with API, IRL 9: Universal connector with 10+ platforms

options.text: No e-commerce platform integrations
Integration with 1-2 major platforms (e.g., Shopify)
3-5 platform integrations (Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento)
5-10 platform integrations with bi-directional sync
10+ integrations with RESTful API and marketplace apps
Universal connector supporting 20+ platforms with no-code integration builder

questions.text: What employee management and workforce optimization features do you offer?
questions.helpText: Track scheduling, time tracking, and performance management. IRL 1-2: Manual scheduling, IRL 3-4: Basic digital scheduling, IRL 5-6: Time tracking and payroll, IRL 7-8: Performance analytics, IRL 9: AI-powered workforce optimization

options.text: Manual scheduling with no time tracking
Basic digital scheduling and shift management
Time clock integration and payroll connectivity
Performance tracking with sales per hour and conversion metrics
Advanced workforce analytics with labor forecasting and compliance tracking
AI-powered workforce optimization with predictive scheduling and task management

questions.text: What marketplace or third-party seller capabilities do you support?
questions.helpText: For marketplace retailers, track multi-seller management. IRL 1-2: Single seller only, IRL 3-4: <10 sellers, IRL 5-6: 10-100 sellers, IRL 7-8: 100-1K sellers with automation, IRL 9: 1K+ sellers with AI moderation

options.text: Single seller/retailer only (no marketplace)
<10 third-party sellers with manual onboarding
10-100 sellers with seller dashboard and basic tools
100-1,000 sellers with automated onboarding and performance tracking
1,000-10,000 sellers with seller financing and marketing tools
10,000+ sellers with AI-powered seller matching, fraud detection, and moderation

questions.text: What sustainability and ESG tracking do you provide for retail operations?
questions.helpText: Track environmental impact metrics for retail. IRL 1-2: No tracking, IRL 3-4: Basic energy monitoring, IRL 5-6: Carbon footprint tracking, IRL 7-8: Circular economy features, IRL 9: Full ESG reporting with product lifecycle

options.text: No sustainability or ESG tracking
Basic energy consumption monitoring
Carbon footprint tracking for operations and shipping
Product sustainability scores and eco-friendly product badges
Circular economy features (returns, refurbishment, recycling programs)
Full ESG reporting with product lifecycle analysis and supply chain transparency
